title: Mixture-of-Experts Top-k Routing
signature: def moe_forward(x, W_router, experts, k) -> tuple
hints: Softmax over all E router logits first. Then pick the k largest probabilities per token; np.argsort(-probs, kind='stable') puts the lower index first on ties.
Gates are the chosen probabilities divided by their sum, so each token's k gates sum to 1.
f_e counts assignments (how many of the T*k slots went to expert e); P_e averages the full softmax probabilities. The loss is E * sum_e f_e * P_e.
